200.description:
Geocode a free-text query (`query`) or a structured address (`street`, `city`, `county`, `state`, `country`, `postalcode`) with Nominatim (`GET nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search`, format jsonv2, addressdetails and extratags on). Returns places with their OSM type and id, coordinates, category/type, address breakdown and bounding box; with `polygon: true` also the boundary GeoJSON, so a city or neighbourhood polygon can feed `search_elements`. | `lon` | number |  |

200.description:
Find OSM elements by tag inside a bounding box, a radius around a point, an administrative area (relation id) or a polygon, through the Overpass API that powers the website's Query Features tool (`POST query.openstreetmap.org/query-features`, Overpass QL `out tags center`). `tags` is a map of tag key to value; the value `*` means the key must exist. Returns typed elements (node/way/relation) with id, tags, node coordinates or way/relation centre, and the data timestamp. Overpass has no cursor: a result that reaches `limit` is marked partial; tile the area or raise `limit`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `elements` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `center` | object | Overpass `center` of a way or relation (centroid of its bounding box); null for nodes and when Overpass could not compute it. |
| `id` | number | Numeric OSM element id. |
| `lat` | number | Node latitude; null for ways and relations. |
| `lon` | number | Node longitude; null for ways and relations. |
| `tags` | object | OSM tags exactly as the source returns them (string values keyed by tag name); `{}` when the element has no tags. |
| `type` | string | OSM element type. |
| `url` | string | https://www.openstreetmap.org/{type}/{id} |
